title: The Turning-Point Audit: What Really Changed in Delhi Capitals’s Best Seasons?
dek: What actually changed when Delhi Capitals were at their best? Comparing their three best seasons with the rest, phase by phase, finds the turning points.
excerpt: In Delhi Capitals' best seasons, the biggest improvement relative to the league came in powerplay batting. That is where the turning points in their history were made.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

sections.heading: What Separates the Best Seasons
body: Good seasons are remembered for players and moments. An audit asks a narrower question: in which part of the game were Delhi Capitals most improved, relative to the league, when they were at their best?
Their three best seasons by win rate were {{ev:tp-best}}. CricField compared them with all other seasons across six phases of batting and bowling.

sections.heading: The Turning Point
body: The largest advantage came in {{ev:tp-top}}: {{ev:tp-gain}} runs an over better, relative to the league, than in other seasons.

For the other phases: powerplay batting {{ev:tp-g-ppbat}}, middle-overs batting {{ev:tp-g-midbat}}, death batting {{ev:tp-g-deathbat}}, powerplay bowling {{ev:tp-g-ppbowl}}, middle-overs bowling {{ev:tp-g-midbowl}} and death bowling {{ev:tp-g-deathbowl}} runs an over (positive = better in the best seasons).

sections.heading: Why It Matters
body: The phase that separated the best seasons is the phase most worth protecting in squad building.

sections.heading: Three Seasons Is a Small Sample
body: Comparing three seasons with the rest is a small-sample exercise; a single exceptional player can drive a whole phase. The finding is a pointer, not a law.
Repeating the audit with the best five seasons would test whether it holds.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Powerplay batting Made the Difference
body: Delhi Capitals' best seasons were defined most by powerplay batting.
Future squads should treat that phase as the franchise's proven route to success.
